FAQ

What is Apple Watch Digital Crown and where do buyers see it?

Digital Crown is the physical rotating and clickable crown on Apple Watch — scroll lists, zoom content, scrub values with crown rotation; press the crown to confirm, dismiss, or navigate; haptic feedback on supported hardware. Marketing often references Digital Crown, Crown Scroll, Crown Click, Haptic Crown, or 数字表冠 / 表冠 on gallery frames. This page covers crown hardware control as-lead — not iPhone Action Button, not Double Tap pinch gestures, not ECG waveforms as-lead.

Does a crown-aware watchOS app auto-translate Digital Crown marketing on the China listing?

No. Crown scroll handlers, crown click actions, and haptic feedback control in-app behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

How is Digital Crown different from Action Button, Double Tap, and ECG?

Action Button covers the iPhone side button under Settings → Action Button — 操作按钮. Double Tap covers pinch-twice wrist gestures on supported Apple Watch models — 轻点两下. ECG covers electrocardiogram waveform recording as-lead — 心电图; Crown may appear as finger contact during ECG capture on the ECG page only. Digital Crown covers crown scroll, crown click, haptic feedback, and crown-driven navigation — 数字表冠, 表冠, 表冠滚动, 表冠按压.

How is Digital Crown different from Watch Faces, Smart Stack, AssistiveTouch, and Unlock with Watch?

Watch Faces covers face gallery browsing — 表盘图库. Smart Stack covers the widget stack on the watch face — 智能叠放. AssistiveTouch covers floating on-screen assistive menus — 辅助触控. Unlock with Apple Watch covers paired-Watch iPhone unlock. Digital Crown covers crown hardware scroll, click, and haptic navigation when that is your lead gallery story.

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. Crown API implementation, scroll handlers, and haptic engine code are outside scope.

No. side-button, crown-haptics, digital-crown-gestures, watch-crown, crown-scroll, and crown-click search intents fold onto this Digital Crown-as-lead page. AppLocale does not publish separate twin slug pages for those variants.
